name: beachcombing
title_zh: 潮水退去后替你扫三遍滩面的拾遗器
tagline_zh: 大潮那两小时能挖到什么、几点回头才不会被围住——它先算撤退时刻再谈收获，11 省 51 处点位带方言别名和吃法。
tagline_en: What is diggable in the two hours around a spring low tide, and when to turn back before the water closes in. Safe-exit time comes first, harvest second, across 51 sites in 11 coastal provinces.
why_zh: 最难得的是它给自己设了上限：走天文骨架估算时，适用性评分强制压到五档里的第二档，不假装精确。
why_en: The rare part is the ceiling it puts on itself: when it falls back to an astronomical skeleton estimate, the suitability rating is capped at the second of five levels rather than faked.
limit_zh: 只覆盖中国大陆沿海，内置点库 11 省 51 处，其余靠 geocoding 兜底。没接真实潮汐 API 时走农历半日潮天文骨架，正文标「估算 ±1h」且评分不超过五档中的第二档。明确不做钓鱼预报、不做生物图像识别、不做休渔期与保护区的法律核对。
limit_en: Mainland Chinese coast only — 51 built-in sites across 11 provinces, everything else falls back to geocoding. Without a real tide API it computes a lunar semidiurnal skeleton, labelled "estimated ±1h" and capped at the second of five suitability levels. It explicitly declines fishing forecasts, species photo ID, and any legal check on closed seasons or protected areas.
title_en: A beachcomber that sweeps the strandline three times after.
